name: bxrig
shortDescription: BxRig brings an opinionated, beautiful and efficient desktop to Linux, built for developers.

matchbox.note: MatchBox 0.14.0 built by CI from the `bxcachy` branch (develop plus the open BxRig pull requests #149-#155 and the VM fixes #156-#161, #166 and #167: break in nested loops, closed stdout, variables.fn(), switch var slots and default jump, panic messages, struct built-ins on the variables scope, len() and find() counting characters, and the terminal UI canvas with native runner support, built with the bif-tui feature) and published to S3; switch back to a released version through mvm once those pull requests ship.
